Un paraíso tropical se convierte en una de las islas más mortales del mundo debido a ataques de tiburones.

En la costa de Nueva Jersey, el verano de 1916 marcó el nacimiento del miedo a los tiburones en los EE. UU. Los investigadores creen que deben resolver el mayor misterio relacionado con el ataque de tiburones antes de que la historia se repita.
San Diego es uno de los destinos costeros más visitados de Estados Unidos. Pero en 2009, esta comunidad se vio sacudida por una serie de ataques de tiburones.
La costa de Recife es uno de los lugares más peligrosos debido a los ataques de tiburones.

Mr. Flamingo is worried because his son Gabby's feathers have turned white. Cosmicrew discovers that Gabby has stopped eating seaweed, causing the color to fade. After a fire, everyone helps rebuild the kitchen and Gabby is eating well again.

A storm causes flooding at Crunchy Beaver's dam. The Cosmicrew steps in to reinforce the river bank. Koka, an admirer of Storm, faces challenges and proves his bravery by saving Storm and controlling the flood. Everyone celebrates his heroism.

Momo, the star panda, is causing a stir in the plaza, unleashing chaos among his fans. Cosmicrew intervenes to maintain order and prevent a disaster when the stage begins to collapse. They discover that Momo is stronger and more agile than he seems.

May, a peacock, goes missing. The Cosmicrew find her wearing a pink feather dress, but she has trouble flying. Rainbow rescues her, and May decides to accept her gray feathers. Rainbow promises to design a new dress for her.

The Round Ear Dancer is a weasel who uses her dance to steal and deceive. While Grandpa Long Beard sleeps, Cosmic crew discovers her plan. With mint oil, Rainbow helps keep Grandpa awake and stops the weasel, saving the party.

Scarlet falls into the canyon while playing with her Flash Jet. Flash and the Cosmicrew rescue her, braving hazards such as a landslide and falling rocks. Despite challenges and mistakes, the team saves Scarlet through bravery and collaboration.

Meteor the pig joins Cosmicrew and faces his first rescue mission after a mine collapse. Although nervous, with the support of Mack the pangolin and Storm, he manages to stay calm and use the glider to save them from danger.

Flash tricks Meteor into eating his vegetables, but while saving a sika deer, they are swept away by a waterfall. After getting trapped in the forest, they feed Sika, who helps them retrieve the backpack. They return by boat, overcoming torrents.
